nurse.text: Fàilte! Welcome to Stornoway Sanctuary. You look as if you've crossed the Minch in a force eight. Pop them on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There's a kettle on, and a plate of bannocks. You're welcome to the bannocks if you leave me the crumbs. Poor things, they're peely-wally. All better.
There you go. Mòran taing, that's thank you very much, for being so patient. Mind the wind on the way out.
The Ark's in the corner, it's the one with the sea-view. Have a click.

else.text: No bother. Enjoy the town, and mind the swings on a Sunday.
